text:
Seated in a forest glen,
by a reed-fringed stream,
I mused one day, then, growing drowsy,
found myself sunk in a dream.

A figure rose from the brook,
half man and half goat;
he had hooves instead of feet,
and a beard adorned his throat.

On a rustic reed pipe
that hybrid creature played sweetly,
and I forgot all earthly care,
for I knew that it was Pan.

Nymphs and satyrs gathered
to enjoy the merry sound.

Too soon I woke, regretful,
and returned to human dwellings;
but I would live in country valleys
and hear Pan’s pipe again.

translation.title: To Pan
